description: Find an accessible element (waiting for it if needed) and click its center. The reliable way to press a named button or link.

exact.description: Require an exact match instead of a substring

role.description: Accessible role, e.g. 'button', 'menu item', 'text', 'terminal' (Linux AT-SPI) or 'Button', 'Edit' (Windows UI Automation)

text.description: Match against the name OR the value

waitMs.description: How long to wait for the element (default 5000)

name: capsulate_click_element
title: Click a UI element
